data.name: Jawariyah
data.gender_notes: Jawariyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Jawariyah refers to the wife of the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him). She was a companion of the Prophet and one of the earliest converts to Islam. The name Jawariyah carries the meaning “Wife of the Prophet Muhammad” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jawariyah usually hope their child will grow to embody wife of the prophet muhammad and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of devotion, loyalty, and humility
data.etymology: Jawariyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wife of the Prophet Muhammad.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawariyah total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: جوارية
in_arabic.meaning: اسم يعني الجارية أو الأمة الحرة
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، يعني الجارية أو الأمة الحرة، وقد ورد ذكره في القرآن الكريم، مشتق من جَوْرِيَّةٍ، وهي الأمة المملوكة التي تخدم أهل البيت، كما أنها تحمل معنى الجواز والمرور السريع، ويدل على الخفة والسرعة في التنقل

in_urdu.name: جوارِیہ
in_urdu.meaning: جوار یا غلامہ، ایک خوبصورت معنی
in_urdu.long_meaning: یہ نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، جو 'جَوْرِيَّة' سے بنا ہے، معنی ایک آزاد خادمہ یا ایک ایسی شخصیت جو اپنے مالک کے لئے کام کرتی ہے، اس کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں بھی آیا ہے، اور یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمان معاشرے میں بھی روایتی اہمیت رکھتا ہے

in_hindi.name: जवारीयह
in_hindi.long_meaning: यह नाम अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है एक स्वतंत्र दासी या एक ऐसा व्यक्ति जो अपने मालिक के लिए काम करती है, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में भी पारंपरिक महत्व रखता है, और इसकी जड़ें इस्लामी परंपरा में हैं

in_pashto.name: جوارية

in_english.name: Jawariyah
in_english.meaning: a freed slave or a servant girl
in_english.long_meaning: The name Jawariyah originates from Arabic roots, specifically from 'j-w-r' which connotes the idea of moving swiftly or passing by, the name is mentioned in the Quran as one of the names of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad, it signifies a freed slave or a servant girl, embodying the values of freedom, service, and humility in Islamic tradition

data.cultural_impact: The name Jawariyah holds significant cultural importance in Islamic history as it is associated with this unique figure in Islam. Jawariyah was a valued companion of the Prophet and played an important role in the early Muslim community. She is remembered as an exemplary Muslim woman and a source of inspiration for Muslim women throughout history.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Jawariyah carries profound meaning as it is a reminder of the deep connection that exists between the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) and his followers. Jawariyah's dedication and loyalty to the Prophet serve as a model for all Muslims to strive for a strong relationship with their Lord and Prophet. Additionally, the name Jawariyah can be seen as a symbol of the Women's role in shaping the community of believers in the earliest days of Islam and their ongoing contribution to the fulfillment of Allah's blessings on humanity.
